observation: Glass impact appears to produce only faint cracks/limited breakup; no convincing outward shard spray or trailing fragments with the brick.
expected_behavior: A fast, heavy brick striking center of a large pane should cause a dense radial fracture and an energetic outward ejection of many shards, with visible separation in depth and fragments trailing behind the brick.
actual_behavior: Impact event is barely readable; shards/debris are minimal or not visible, and the brick is not clearly seen punching through with a fragment trail.
